items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it

items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it

items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it

items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it

items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it

items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it

items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it

items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it

items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it
items.item: Refuse the grain when raw history still predicts a held-out future after the grain is known, measured against a shuffled-history floor.

items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it
items.item: Walk the history length 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 turns until older history stops improving held-out prediction.

items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it
items.item: Report UNRESOLVED rather than accepting the grain when the longest allowed history still contributes information.

items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it

items.phase_title: Derive the canonical grain instead of choosing it
